title: Answer: experience is fixed by a state's computational role

statements.text: A state is a conscious experience when it plays the right role in implementing the right algorithm. Whether experience is anything beyond that role is left open: it may be nothing more, or sui generis phenomenal properties for which the role suffices. Either way it is derived from computation in the sense that the computation settles it.

sources.quote: there is nothing more to a state’s being conscious than its playing a certain role in implementing a computation
